items.quote: Bitte begleichen Sie den Betrag binnen 14 Tagen ab dem Rechnungsdatum ohne Abzug.
items.computation: The invoice is dated 19.11.2026 (Thursday). Payment is due 14 days from the invoice date. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB, the day of the event (19.11.) is not counted, so counting starts 20.11.2026. Under § 188 Abs. 1 BGB, the 14-day period ends on 03.12.2026 (Thursday). This is not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in NW, so under § 193 BGB the date is not shifted. Due date: 03.12.2026. (Allow about 1 business day for the bank transfer to arrive, i.e. send by 02.12.2026.)
